proposed_compilation_title: 2003 General Obligation Bond Program: Master Record

proposed_table_of_contents.section: Editorial note
proposed_table_of_contents.content: The 2003 program was set at $130,000,000 by R-02-30 and grew through the Decade Plan resolution R-03-215 and its amendment R-03-265 to $156,838,460 in general obligation authority. Tables 1 and 2 report by department category excluding art; the scope sheets and purpose chart report by ballot purpose including art, so their totals differ. The Decade Plan criteria appear once, inside R-02-30. The Street Bonds purpose failed at the October 28, 2003 election; its projects were resubmitted in 2004 and are documented in the 2004 Street Bond Program record.

recommended_publication_form.rationale: One 92-page master record of 21 files in five sections, just under the 100-150 page threshold, so it need not be split. The three enacted resolutions govern everything else; the tables, rankings and EPC decision show how projects were chosen; and the ten purpose sheets list what each ballot purpose funded. None of the short sheets or tables has standalone meaning without the resolutions.
recommended_publication_form.split_option: If a split is preferred, Sections 1-3 (61 pages: resolutions, allocation and selection) and Sections 4-5 (31 pages: purpose scopes and public information) divide cleanly.

provenance_notes: All 23 official files fetched 2026-09-13 from the raw URLs (queue source URLs end in /view, which serve an HTML wrapper); each returned HTTP 200 with PDF leading bytes.
The five assigned members' archive copies are byte-identical to the official files.
Inspection depth varies by file and is recorded per file; the image-only resolutions were read on their title, section and signature pages, not every page of project listings.

Correction to the five assigned checkpoints: their series_relationship text says the family has eleven purpose scope sheets; there are ten (Fire, Library, Parks and Recreation, Police, Public Facilities, Public Transportation, Senior Family and Community, Storm Sewer, Street, Zoo BioPark and Museum). The checkpoints are immutable and are corrected here.
